description: A «ENT_ORG_001» placeholder leaks into the signed deliverable. The pre-delivery scan must catch and hard-error.
input_text: This NDA is between «ENT_ORG_001» and Beta Holdings LLC, effective January 1, 2026.
expected_post_rehydrate_text: This NDA is between ACME Corp and Beta Holdings LLC, effective January 1, 2026.
deliberately_broken_scenario: If «ENT_ORG_001» is NOT in the key store, the placeholder leaks. The pre-delivery scan for «ENT_ prefix must fire a PrivacyFilterError.
detection: Pre-delivery scan: grep for «ENT_ prefix in final draft before write.
recovery: Hard error before write. Do not deliver the document. Investigate why the token was not in the key store.
